faq_1_q: So... what is Career CoPilot, actually?
faq_1_a: It's your career command center. We take your resume and give you: (1) a detailed readiness score with specific fixes, (2) mock interviews with real feedback, (3) a career path showing how to get from A to B, and (4) tools for cover letters, networking, salary negotiation, and more. Think of it as having a career coach, resume writer, and interview trainer — all in one place, available anytime.
faq_2_q: How does the resume analysis actually work?
faq_2_a: Drop in your resume (PDF, Word, image, or paste it). Our AI checks it against ATS compatibility rules, keyword relevance for your target market, formatting best practices, and industry standards. You get a score out of 100 plus a line-by-line breakdown of what's working and what needs fixing. It's like having a recruiter review your resume — but it takes seconds, not days.
faq_3_q: Can I really practice interviews with AI?
faq_3_a: Yes — and it's surprisingly good. You paste a job description, our AI asks you relevant behavioral and technical questions based on your resume and the role. You answer out loud or in text, and you get instant feedback using the STAR method. It tells you what landed, what was vague, and how to improve. It's awkward the first time. By the third, you'll feel ready for the real thing.
faq_4_q: I'm thinking about switching careers. Can this help?
faq_4_a: This is exactly what the Career Path Planner was built for. It analyzes your current resume against your target role, identifies the skill gaps you actually need to close, and maps out bridge roles — intermediate positions that get you from where you are to where you want to be. It's not generic advice. It's your specific roadmap.
faq_5_q: Are the jobs in the Opportunity Finder real and current?
faq_5_a: Yes. We pull from real, active job postings across LinkedIn, Indeed, company career pages, and more. Each result includes a match analysis showing exactly how your resume stacks up against the requirements. No dead links. No ghost jobs.
faq_6_q: I'm applying to jobs in another country. Can you help?
faq_6_a: That's exactly what the Resume Localizer is for. Select your target country (Japan, Germany, Canada, etc.), and we'll reformat your resume to match local standards — from photo expectations to section ordering to date formats. It's the difference between looking like a local candidate and looking like an outsider.
faq_7_q: Is my data safe with you?
faq_7_a: We take this seriously. Your resume and personal data are used only to power our tools for you. We don't sell, rent, or share your information with third parties. All data transmission is encrypted. For the full picture, read our Privacy Policy.
faq_8_q: What does the free plan include?
faq_8_a: You get 50 starter credits — enough for a full resume analysis, a mock interview session, and a cover letter. It's a genuine way to see if the tools work for you before committing. In fact, we'd rather you try it free and love it than pay and wonder.
faq_9_q: How does the Portfolio Website Builder work?
faq_9_a: Upload your resume. Our AI extracts your skills, experience, and projects. Add a photo (or generate one with AI), pick a style, and we build you a professional showcase site with a public URL. No coding. No templates to wrestle with. Five minutes, and you have something you'd be proud to share.
faq_10_q: What's the deal with Verified Talent and these digital credentials?
faq_10_a: After you score high on a resume analysis, you can mint a Proof-of-Talent credential — a verifiable digital badge stored on the blockchain. Think of it as a trust layer on top of your resume. Businesses that want to hire verified talent can discover you in our Talent Vault. And here's the part people love: when a business pays to unlock your profile, you earn a share. Your skills literally pay you.
faq_11_q: What about the English Pro Coach and Certification Prep?
faq_11_a: The English Pro Coach helps you write, read, and listen in professional English — with detailed feedback on grammar, vocabulary, and tone. The Certification Prep tool generates realistic practice tests for Agile certifications (PSM, CSM, etc.) with full explanations for every answer. Both are designed to build real skills, not just check boxes.
faq_12_q: Can AI really help with networking and professional communication?
faq_12_a: It can — in very specific, practical ways. The Email Drafter generates professional emails (thank yous, follow-ups, networking requests) personalized to your resume and the situation. The Networking Assistant goes further: it identifies key contacts at your target company and drafts outreach messages explaining why you should connect. You're not replacing human connection — you're just not starting from a blank page anymore.
faq_13_q: Can I use this for my current job, not just job hunting?
faq_13_a: Absolutely. The Performance Review Prep turns your accomplishments into STAR-format talking points. The Learning Roadmap creates a personalized plan to master any skill. The Event Scout finds conferences and meetups worth attending. Career growth doesn't stop when you're employed — and neither do our tools.

resume_market_hint_vietnam: Vietnamese CV: 1–2 pages, photo common, personal details accepted, highlight certifications and English proficiency level explicitly.
resume_market_hint_singapore: Singapore style: Western-format resume, no photo, 2–3 pages acceptable, include work-rights/visa status line if not a citizen or PR.
resume_market_hint_australia: Australian resume: Western format, no photo, 2–3 pages acceptable, include work-rights/visa status line if not a citizen or PR.
